title: F001 rescope: DontPanic subtree mirror only; upstream sync operator-handled
body: F001 preflight surfaced a scope ambiguity that the v4 plan-doctor missed: original step language asked the implementer to bump agent-conventions/VERSION + commit upstream + subtree-pull, but the implementer worktree is scoped to $HOME/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic and cannot reach $HOME/Documents/GitHub/agent-conventions/. The v4 F001 plan-doctor path-token regex `[\w./-]+\.\w+` misses extensionless tokens like `agent-conventions/VERSION`, so this slipped through lock-time validation. RESCOPE: implementer edits ONLY DontPanic subtree mirror at claude/shared/ (audit.schema.json + VERSION + CHANGELOG.md + Pydantic mirror at models/) + supervisor.py + tests. Operator handles upstream agent-conventions push out-of-band after F001 closes (cherry-pick changes into agent-conventions, tag v1.8.0, push). Step 8 added: explicit do-not-touch warning. Acceptance #8 added: no edits attempted outside DontPanic. v4.x candidate (doctor enhancement): widen path-token regex to catch extensionless filenames (VERSION, Makefile, Dockerfile, etc.) + scan plan.md narrative not just features.json steps.

title: F001 close-out (environmental_reproduction_failure) + v4.x candidate: iter0-blocked-with-advisory-only short-circuit
body: iter0 implementer signed off cleanly (2.59M tokens). Local verification: schema parsing-enum addition + Pydantic mirror + VERSION 1.8.0 + CHANGELOG + supervisor.py parse-warning sites flipped + tests updated + 1928 sweep green + sanitization clean. iter0 auditor returned audit_status=blocked because its sandbox couldn't run pytest — sole finding is advisory/test_coverage with recommendation to re-run in writable shell. Classic environmental_reproduction_failure shape. Operator close-out via dontpanic close --operator-resolved --reason environmental_reproduction_failure --allow-missing-breaker (--allow-missing-breaker required because terminal was 'blocked after 1 round', not 'stopped_no_progress' — close CLI safety check assumed the latter). v4.x CANDIDATE: v4 F003's ENVIRONMENTAL_BLOCKER short-circuit fires when verdict=blocked AND findings=[] (empty), promoting to stopped_environmental_blocker. v4 F002's reconciliation logic only fires post-no_progress threshold. Neither handles the common iter0 case of 'verdict=blocked AND all findings classify as advisory/environmental per F003 taxonomy'. Should extend the F003 short-circuit (or v4 F002 reconciliation) to fire from finding-class classification on the first blocked iter, not just empty findings. Would have auto-promoted this volley to stopped_environmental_blocker, sparing the operator-resolved CLI invocation. Logged as carry for a future v4.x/v5 plan.

title: F002 close-out (spec_ambiguity): strict-pin design disagreement + Plan 004 envelope mismatch
body:
iter0 implementer subprocess timed out (D031 recurrence — 3rd occurrence this week). iter1 implementer signed_off at 4.22M tokens. Substantive work delivered: 1929 tests passing (+1 since v4.1 F001), Plan 010 F002 fixture now loads real envelope via PLAN_010_F002_REAL_FINDINGS (acceptance #2 delivered), new test_plan_004_f002_replay_full_dispatch_volley_reaches_clean_terminal lands at test_shlex_safe_command_guard_f003.py with synthetic _ParseBreakingExecutor that drives full dispatch_volley with parse-breaking commands_run end-to-end (acceptance #3 in spirit). Two iter1 auditor findings, both judged spec_ambiguity not defect:

(1) HIGH/correctness — strict `result.final_status == "needs_changes"` not implemented. Implementer chose to pin `iter0_data["audit_status"] == "needs_changes"` instead. RATIONALE: This is the THIRD round of the same design disagreement (v3 F002 D007, v4 F002 D007, v4.1 F002 again). Implementer's articulate analysis: prior strict pin attempts coupled the test to incidental no-progress mechanics (the v4 attempt pinned `stopped_no_progress` which is a threshold side-effect, not the verdict invariant). Their fix: widened fixture so round 0 replays real envelope (audit_status=needs_changes) and round 1 returns synthetic signoff so the volley terminates cleanly. Strict assertion lands on round 0's on-disk audit envelope. Auditor wants the supervisor-terminal pin; implementer pinned the verdict-data pin. Both are defensible interpretations of 'strict terminal assertion'. Spec_ambiguity per v3 F003 taxonomy.

(2) MEDIUM/test_coverage — new full-volley replay test hard-codes synthetic parse-breaking command instead of loading the on-disk Plan 004 F002 envelope. ROOT CAUSE: Plan 004 F002 implementer envelope on disk has CLEAN commands_run (5 well-formed pytest/ruff/python invocations, no parse-breaking input). The original D025 shlex crash happened DURING the Plan 004 F002 dispatch run but the persisted envelope captured commands cleanly. Spec text 'mocked executors that return the Plan 004 F002 reproducer envelope (parse-breaking input)' is self-contradictory — the envelope cannot both be loaded verbatim AND contain parse-breaking input that isn't there. Implementer correctly synthesized parse-breaking prose to exercise the F003 wrapper (otherwise the test would be a no-op). Spec_ambiguity not defect.

(3) ADVISORY/test_coverage — codex sandbox couldn't run pytest (environmental_reproduction_failure, recurring).

v5 plan candidate: strict-pin design tension has now surfaced 3 times. Worth either (a) explicit spec language clarifying volley-terminal vs envelope-verdict pin, or (b) a harness helper that pins both invariants atomically. Also worth: post-F003 audit envelope re-capture step that records the parse-breaking command_run string verbatim into a replay fixture, since the on-disk envelope's normalized commands_run loses the breaking shape.
